headline: Over 500 Mexican LPG Companies Seek Price Adjustments Amid Operating Losses
summary: More than 500 LP gas distribution companies in Mexico have formally asked authorities to update regulated retail profit margins to offset inflation and prevent ongoing operating losses.
why: LPG is the primary residential cooking and heating fuel for millions of Mexican households; changes to price caps impact energy distributors and household energy budgets.

impacts.name: Mexican LPG Distribution
impacts.why: Distributors report operational losses under existing price cap margins and seek inflation adjustments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
